name: pixel-crew
description: Pixel-art progress bar with the Claude mascot and a side panel that turns your subagents into a crew of characters (developer, artist, researcher, tester, Codex...).

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band and the Agents panel. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then your system language (English, Portuguese or Spanish; anything else falls back to English).

size.title: Terminal art size
size.description: How big the band's mascot and the Agents panel's characters are in a terminal: small (half size: the band takes five rows) or full (the band takes nine). /crew-size switches it in a session and keeps the choice.
